The publisher named on the listing is Комунальне підприємство "Новомосковськ водоканал" Дніпропетровської області. Its keywords include вартість послуг. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2021-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
